_comment: Shared fixture for the search matching/similar split. Loaded by the Go tests (cmd/cli/basic/knowledge/search_split_test.go) and the UI tests (ui/lib/searchSplit.test.ts) so the CLI and the UI cannot diverge. Hits are in the order the server returns them (score descending). 'matched' is what the server sets (score > 0); a hit without 'matched' comes from a daemon that predates the field and counts as matching. Expected strings use null when the message is not shown.

cases.name: none matching
cases.similar_notice: 3 similar results don't match the query.

cases.name: mixed
cases.similar_notice: 2 similar results don't match the query.

cases.name: score exactly zero does not match
cases.similar_notice: 1 similar result doesn't match the query.

cases.name: matched flag absent counts as matching
